```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| warning: false
#| message: false

seuil_obs <- 30  

n_obs <- DB_full %>% filter(ID == params$species) %>% nrow()

cat(sprintf('<div class="obs-count"> Records : <strong>%d</strong></div>\n', n_obs))

if (n_obs < seuil_obs) {
  cat(sprintf(
    '<div class="obs-warning"> ⚠ Low number of records (&lt; %d).</div>\n',
    seuil_obs
  ))
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| warning: false
#| message: false
ids <- col_synonyms(col_match(params$species)$usage_id)$label
cat('<div class="dropdown" id="menu-ids">\n')
cat('<button class="dropdown-btn" onclick="document.getElementById(\'menu-ids\').classList.toggle(\'open\')">Synonyms ▾</button>\n')
cat('<div class="dropdown-content scroller">\n')
for (i in ids) {
  cat(sprintf('<span>%s</span>\n', i))
}
cat('</div>\n</div>\n')
```
